name: 0xArchive API
description: REST API for current and historical market data from Hyperliquid and Lighter. Hyperliquid coverage includes core perpetuals, Spot, HIP-3 builder perpetuals, and HIP-4 outcome markets. Lighter coverage includes two deployments: Lighter mainnet under /v1/lighter and Lighter on Robinhood Chain under /v1/rh-lighter. Account positions are available for Hyperliquid core, HIP-3, and both Lighter deployments. Coverage and access requirements vary by route. See https://docs.0xarchive.io/ for authentication, limits, and examples.
